1:
The value of the expression $\log_{\sqrt2}3\cdot\log_{\sqrt3}2$ equals
A. $\frac14$  B. $3^2$  C. $2^3$  D. 4
2:
A triangle has sides of length 4, 5 and 6. The cosine of the largest interior angle of this triangle equals
A. $\frac18$  B. $\frac{9}{16}$  C. $\frac34$  D. $-\frac34$
3:
The remainder of dividing the polynomial $W(x)=5x^3-3x^2+2x-7$ by the binomial $x+2$ equals
A. $(-63)$  B. $(-39)$  C. 25  D. 41
5: Compute the limit $\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac{4n^3-2n+1}{3n^3-n^2-2n+3}$. In the boxes below, enter from left to right the first, second and third digit of the infinite decimal expansion of the result obtained.
6: The function f is given by $f(x)=2x^3-4x^2+9x$ for every real x. The point $P=(x_0,18)$ belongs to the graph of f. Calculate $x_0$ and find the equation of the tangent line to the graph of f at point P.
9: Given is the infinite geometric series $2x-\frac{6x}{x-1}+\frac{18x}{(x-1)^2}-\frac{54x}{(x-1)^3}+\ldots$. Determine all values of the variable x (different from 0 and 1) for which the sum of this series exists and equals $\frac{15}{2}$.
10: Solve the equation $\sin(5x)+\cos x=0$ in the set $\langle-\frac{\pi}{2},\frac{\pi}{2}\rangle$.
11: A box contains n balls ($n\ge3$), exactly 2 of which are black and the rest white. One ball is drawn from the box and set aside. If the drawn ball is white, a black ball is put into the box; if it is black, a white ball is put into the box. After this change, the probability of drawing a white ball from the box equals $\frac{37}{50}$. Calculate n.
13: The convex quadrilateral ABCD is inscribed in a circle of radius 4. Angles BAD and BCD are right angles. The diagonals AC and BD of this quadrilateral intersect at point E such that $|BE|=3\cdot|DE|$ and $|BD|=2\cdot|AE|$. Calculate the side lengths of quadrilateral ABCD.
15: Circle $o_1$ with center $S_1$ is given by the equation $(x-6)^2+(y+1)^2=16$. Circle $o_2$ has center $S_2$ such that $\vec{S_1S_2}=[-4,4]$. The radii of these circles are equal. Figure F consists of the two circles $o_1$ and $o_2$. Points M and N are the intersection points of figure F with the axis of symmetry that has a positive slope. Determine point K lying on one of the axes of symmetry of figure F such that the area of triangle MNK equals 40.
